sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as num_trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(CAST(yt AS FLOAT) / anglers), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 145 AND fish_date_season = 2 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC LIMIT 20
